implemented: Equation 3: base plus elementwise weighted task displacements
Equation 4: signs use >= 0; strict majority filters opposite signs at each coordinate, ties retain all
Equation 5: softmax of absolute task-vector magnitude over retained experts; temperature exactly one
source_discrepancy: The Qwen script chooses contributors using signs[i].any() over the entire parameter tensor. This need not enforce coordinate-wise majority. We implement the paper and the Llama script coordinate-wise semantics; regression test excludes a large minority at each coordinate.
differences: Experts adapt only q_proj and v_proj with rank-eight LoRA instead of full-model fine-tuning.
Fusion uses FP32 effective B@A matrices, never factor-space averaging; no rank truncation or gauge dependence.
The Llama source adds 1e-6 to softmax denominators. We use exact normalized softmax as in paper Equation 5.
Experts are trained independently from identical base and initial factors; this is a specialist-fusion comparator, not online fixed-memory learning.
Task order variation affects sequential controls; independent expert fusion is permutation invariant by design.
No curvature is measured; magnitude is the paper's proposed proxy.
No paper benchmark reproduction or claim of theoretical guarantees.
controls: Unweighted arithmetic mean of exactly the same expert effective updates in the same dense representation
Fixed rank-eight replay with a fixed-total 64-example reservoir
